limits: Pointwise rail bound applies only with R601/R602 intact and IN_AC bounded as declared. It is not a complete single-fault safety proof.
No guaranteed minimum opamp load is credited. Source-only regulators can deliver current but cannot absorb it.
Ideal piecewise clamps bracket forward drop and do not model diode leakage, parasitic capacitance, reverse recovery or internal IC current sharing.
Actual transformer/supply overshoot, phase-inverter loading, cable ESD and regulator stability remain open.
Two-percent resistance allowance includes initial/thermal allowance only, not guaranteed lifetime drift. C601 exact part/tolerance remains open.
Output-clamp behavioral path is a stress surrogate, not a guaranteed OPA2134 output protection model. The0.6mA allocation requires actual full-system verification.
